title: Bar Salts Pineapple Ice Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml By Vampire Vape
description: Dive into the vibrant, tropical flavours of fresh Pineapple with a cooling ice finish with Vampire Vape’s Pineapple Ice. This e-liquid offers a blast of pineapple that's sweet and tangy, followed by a refreshing icy exhale to enhance your vaping experience. The Vampire Vape Bar Salts Shortfills are presented in a convenient 100ml volume, with a 60VG/40PG mix, ensuring a great balance between rich flavour delivery and ample vapour production, ideal for use with a variety of starter kits, pod systems, and MTL setups requiring coils of 0.6ohm or higher. This 60/40 range from Vampire Vape extends their widely acclaimed Bar Salts collection, featuring a lineup of intense flavours inspired by the robust and satisfying hit of disposable vapes. Each flavour is crafted to offer long-lasting satisfaction in a cost-effective and environmentally friendly format. Each shortfill bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, housed in a 120ml bottle to allow space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots. This setup lets you customize your vaping experience by adding nicotine shots to achieve a desired strength, with the potential to mix up to 120ml of 3mg e-liquid.Explore more from Vampire Vape's Bar Salts Shortfill collection, which includes unique flavours like Kiwi Passionfruit Guava and Pink Lemonade, alongside Pineapple Ice, to cater to all tastes.
